title: Initiative gating & sprint runway for SDK rapid experimentation
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Background: DX teams run many small experiments to validate SDK onboarding flows, quickstarts, and example apps. Currently experiments lack a consistent gating model and sprint runway, causing duplicated effort, unclear success signals, and delayed rollouts.

Problem statement: We need a lightweight initiative gating process and a repeatable sprint runway that lets PMs/Design/Eng run 1–2 week SDK experiments with fast feedback, clear guards for promotion to playbooks, and automated telemetry collection.

Goal: Deliver a documented, tool-supported gating pipeline and sprint runway that reduces experiment-to-playbook lead time by 40% and increases playbook adoption lift measurement coverage from ~30% to 80% for SDK/quickstart pilots within one quarter.

Scope: Tooling (templates, checklists, telemetry hooks), governance (gates + reviewers), and a shipped pilot for 3 SDK quickstarts (JavaScript SDK auth flow, Python embeddings quickstart, Node realtime sample). Excludes major infra changes to provision new runtime environments (handled by ENG infra work).
acceptance_criteria: A1: A one-page gating checklist and decision rubric published in Confluence and linked from the initiative template
A2: Sprint-runway template (1–2 week cadence) added to Linear with required tasks and owners
A3: Telemetry schema (user events + success metrics) agreed and implemented in 3 pilot quickstarts
A4: Automated dashboard to track experiment cohorts, pass/fail gates, and adoption lift available in Console
A5: Pilot experiments completed and at least one experiment promoted into the canonical playbook with rollout guidance
tasks: Draft gating checklist and rubric (PM + Design) -> link to draft in docs
Create sprint-runway Linear template with required tickets and owner roles
Implement telemetry hooks for quickstarts (events: install, first-api-call, success-signal)
Instrument Console dashboard (experiment status, funnel conversion, cost per activation)
Run 3 pilot experiments across SDK teams and capture notes/decisions
Convene gating review board at end of each pilot sprint and record decisions
Iterate on checklist from pilot feedback and publish final playbook
notes: 2025-11-20: Kickoff with SDK leads, Design, and Analytics. Agreed to 2-week pilot cadence.
2025-12-04: Design prototype for onboarding checklist validated with two dev advocates.
2026-01-08: Analytics schema proposed; needs minor changes to event names to align with Console conventions.
2026-02-02: Eng capacity constrained for telemetry wiring; agreed to phased rollout and one pilot uses a light-weight SDK shim.
2026-03-10: First pilot (JS SDK auth flow) completed: conversion +15% in test cohort; gate recommends promotion to playbook with UX notes.
stakeholders: SDK Team Leads: Jess K., Omar N.
